title: Elementary Science and Technology — Class 5
description: Class 5 Elementary Science and Technology for the English-speaking primary subsystem: plant and animal life, the human body (breathing and circulation), food, disease prevention, soil and water, weather, matter, energy, electricity, forces and simple machines, the environment and technology. Draft lessons with worked examples, exercises and self-checks.
